meta.description: Build model-corrected evolutionary distance matrices and distance trees (NJ, BIONJ, FastME, UPGMA) with Biopython Bio.Phylo plus R ape/phangorn/FastME.
meta.executed: 9/9 inputs executed (Biopython 1.88, scikit-bio 0.7.3, pandas, R ape 5.8.1 / phangorn 2.12.1); standalone FastME CLI and DAMBE not executable
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs as regression tests plus 2 new inputs (N = 9). Skill Python and R blocks used verbatim (path names only). SYNTHETIC data (data/make_data.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: All values from runs on synthetic alignments with known trees.

methodological_ground.detail: Support read as precision, saturation gate applied, UPGMA refused under rate variation, LogDet used for compositional heterogeneity.

code_usability.detail: Every Skill block runs: the R write.csv to pandas/Bio.Phylo/skbio hand-off, method-once bootstrap with seed, saturation proxy, rooted-replicate Bio.Phylo consensus; all four examples exit 0.

functional_suitability.note: Rooted-replicate consensus, gamma reuse, runnable saturation proxy, counts vs distances and the Python hand-off are fixed and verified. Remaining: 'estimate alpha, do not assume' has no code and the example still hard-codes 0.5; the Trap paragraph still uses Xia Iss >= Iss.c as the criterion although it is optional elsewhere.

reliability.note: NaN-below-0.75 row with njs()/bionjs() fallback verified; no gap-stripping code for the 'identity' warning.

agent_usability.note: Excellent error prevention; small residual inconsistency (Xia gate).

human_usability.note: Natural prompts in usage guide; long description.

security.note: Nothing sensitive; R writes to tempdir.

maintainability.note: Examples seeded and print support; still toy 5-16 bp data, off-topic patristic example, no test alignments.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routing; seeds now present.
